pending.title: Digital Painting
pending.prompt:
Create a dreamy vintage-aesthetic sticker collage composite featuring three cut-out portrait stickers of the person in the photo, arranged overlapping each other. Layer them on top of a soft pastel scrapbook background filled with vintage florals, pearls, ribbons, music sheet paper, and whimsical stickers.

Sticker 1 (top-right, largest): a close-up portrait of the person with a straight-on calm direct gaze, soft neutral expression, long straight hair with soft bangs, and an off-shoulder cream knit top, all inside a white cutout sticker border.

Sticker 2 (left-middle): a close-up portrait of the person with their eyes gently closed and a soft smile, wearing the same off-shoulder cream knit top, inside a white cutout sticker border.

Sticker 3 (bottom-right): a close-up portrait of the person smiling warmly with their hands gently touching their cheeks, wearing a cream knit sweater, inside a white cutout sticker border.

Keep the person's face and identity unchanged in all three stickers. Use a [COLOR_PALETTE: soft pastel] color scheme, cinematic lighting, and a highly detailed scrapbook aesthetic.
